Project Description: The project targets nickel-cobalt mineralization within the Naga Hills Ophiolite belt. The belt comprises ultramafic rocks (dunite, peridotite, harzburgite, serpentinite) that have undergone intense tropical weathering, resulting in lateritic profiles enriched in Ni, Co, and Cr. Recent Critical Mineral Assessment Programme around Apong delineated ~3 sq. km of ultramafic-derived laterite with thicknesses of 1–7 m and Ni values up to 10,548 ppm, justifying detailed subsurface evaluation. The proposed work includes 1:2,000 scale geological mapping, pitting and trenching, 40 boreholes, each of 10 meters (400 m total drilling), resistivity surveys, and mineralogical studies (petrography, XRD, EPMA) to delineate lateral continuity and thickness of Ni-bearing horizons. The project aims to establish resource potential, upgrade exploration confidence, and augment the nickel resource base of Manipur.
